description:
Returns resource URLs/content in this response; it does NOT write any files. Each resource comes back with a ready `fetch` shell command — run it yourself to save the file to its `dest`. Use inline=true only when a `fetch` command could not reach the server; the content then arrives in this response and you must write it to `dest`.

Pass `filename` (string) or `filenames` (array), plus `workspace_dir` (the mapping workflow's) so `dest` matches the workflow's paths; calling with neither filename returns the list of available resources (it does not fail).

Available: sz_json_analyzer.py, sz_schema_generator.py, sz_verbatim_check.py, sz_routing_report.py, senzing_entity_specification.md, senzing_mapping_examples.md, identifier_crosswalk.json

mapping_workflow and analyze_record already return each resource's `fetch` command — you do not need this tool to run them.

If a previously-known fetch instruction stops working, call this tool again to obtain the current one.

filename.description:
Resource filename to retrieve (e.g. "sz_json_analyzer.py",
"senzing_entity_specification.md"). Ignored when `filenames` is provided.

filenames.description:
Multiple resource filenames to retrieve in a single call.
Takes precedence over `filename` when provided.

inline.description: Returns resource content inline instead of `fetch` commands. NEVER the first call: run the resource's `fetch` command first, and set inline=true only if that command could not reach the server. This tool writes no files in either mode — inline content must then be written to `dest` by you. Inline responses consume more context tokens. Large resources come back in BOUNDED CHUNKS: a truncated response carries `truncated: true`, `next_offset` and `total_chars` — call again with `offset` = `next_offset` to continue. For the Entity Specification prefer `search_docs`: it serves the same document already split by section, which is cheaper than paging through 75 KB.

offset.description:
Character offset into the resource for `inline=true` pagination. Pass the
`next_offset` from a previous truncated response. Default 0.

workspace_dir.description: Directory the resources belong in — the mapping workflow's `workspace_dir`. Each resource's `dest` is `<workspace_dir>/<filename>`; omitted, `dest` is relative to your shell's current directory. Pass it so a fallback writes to the same paths the workflow uses.

name: download_resource
